title: TRT-3079: fix(cpo): stop enabling the MachineAPI capability in guest clusters
body:
/kind bug
/priority critical-urgent

**This is CI-blocking on main** — e2e jobs creating guests from the ocp/5.1 payload with the TechPreviewNoUpgrade feature set have been failing since ~15:00Z 2026-11-05 (e.g. PR #9958, PR #10041). Default feature set guests are unaffected today.

## Problem

The guest CVO bootstrap container crash-loops with:

```
The ClusterVersion "version" is invalid: spec.capabilities: Invalid value: the MachineAPI capability requires the ClusterAPI capability
```

Guest clusters never become Available and create-guests times out.

## Root cause

- openshift/api#3145 (OCPCLOUD-3725, merged 2026-11-04) added a ClusterVersion CEL validation rejecting MachineAPI without ClusterAPI, gated on the `ClusterAPIOperator` feature gate (currently TechPreviewNoUpgrade/DevPreviewNoUpgrade).
- It reached the payload via the CVO's openshift/api vendor bump (openshift/cluster-version-operator#1506), first present in `rc_payload__5.1.0-0.ci-2026-11-04-230144`.
- HyperShift strips ClusterAPI from the guest capability set (`CalculateEnabledCapabilities`), because it manages guest machines with its own CAPI-based NodePools. The default set therefore selects MachineAPI without ClusterAPI — exactly the combination the new validation rejects in TP guests.

## Fix

Mirror the ClusterAPI removal: drop MachineAPI from the default guest capability set in `CalculateEnabledCapabilities`, unconditionally. Per a HyperShift maintainer, the MachineAPI capability should always be disabled on hosted clusters: machine management is external to the cluster and handled via the NodePool API on the management cluster. This also stays correct when `ClusterAPIOperator` is promoted to Default (planned for this 5.1 dev cycle).

Explicit opt-in is unaffected in practice: the `HostedCluster` `OptionalCapability` enum does not include MachineAPI or ClusterAPI.

## Testing

- `go test ./support/capabilities/...`
- `go test ./control-plane-operator/hostedclusterconfigoperator/controllers/resources/configuration/...`
- `go test ./control-plane-operator/controllers/hostedcontrolplane/`
- `make verify-commit-layout`
- e2e-v2-gke passes on this PR (the job that was failing on every other PR)

Assisted-by: LLM

 	netCaps := sets.New[configv1.ClusterVersionCapability](vCurrent...)
 	netCaps.Delete(configv1.ClusterVersionCapabilityBaremetal)
 	netCaps.Delete(configv1.ClusterVersionCapabilityClusterAPI)
+	netCaps.Delete(configv1.ClusterVersionCapabilityMachineAPI)
 	if !SupportsCompatibilityRequirements(featureSet, releaseVersion) {
 		netCaps.Delete(configv1.ClusterVersionCapabilityCompatibilityRequirements)
 	}
